scores.Biological Plausibility_reason: The proposed CCND1–CDK4/6–RB1–E2F and CCNE1–CDK2 mechanism is well-established, contextually appropriate for breast cancer, and coherently explains Ki-67 variation through heterogeneous cell-cycle entry and progression.
scores.Grounded Mechanistic Synthesis_reason: CCND1, CDK4/6, CCNE1, CDK2, RB1, E2F1/2, and CDKN1B are integrated into a coherent sequence connecting RB phosphorylation and E2F activation to active cycling and elevated Ki-67. No key feature is isolated, although the upstream source of heterogeneous mitogenic activation and the precise link from E2F-driven cycling to Ki-67 abundance remain broad. No synthesis ceiling was applied.
